identity.torch_matches_golden_note: corrected provenance, not a measurement: this cpu-tier run never ran the torch kernel (device=None), so torch-vs-golden equality was never checked and null is the correct record. The false was written by a pre-f12ffe2 serialiser; assert_identical has emitted null for the cpu tier ever since, and raises WorkloadMismatch on a real disagreement, which would have aborted the run before any record was written. Only this flag was changed; every measured figure in this line is exactly as recorded.
